kpis.description_fr: Nombre clients distribution gaz naturel (8 États US, Texas dominant). Hero KPI utility, croissance organique.
kpis.description_en: Natural gas distribution customers (8 US states, Texas dominant). Utility hero KPI, organic growth.
kpis._verify_reason: Le 10-K indique 'approximately 3.4 million residential, commercial, public authority, and industrial customers'. La valeur prétendument extraite de 3.3M est incorrecte.

kpis.signal: Cash machine reglementee: distribution gaz dans 8 etats, 3.4 M clients, hausse soutenue via formula rate mechanisms
kpis.description_fr: RN du segment distribution gaz naturel (Mid-Tex, Kentucky, Louisiane, Mississippi, etc.). 3.4 millions de meteres. Recouvrement ~95% capex en 6 mois via formules tarifaires automatiques.
kpis.description_en: Distribution segment net income (natural gas LDC across 8 states). 3.4M meters. ~95% of capex recovered within 6 months via formula rate mechanisms.

kpis.signal: APT (Atmos Pipeline-Texas): un des plus grands pipelines intrastate du Texas, croissance +20%/an portee par GRIP et capex 5.2 Mds$ rate base
kpis.description_fr: RN segment Pipeline & Storage (APT Texas + transmission Louisiane). Rate base APT 5.24 Mds$, ROE autorise 11.45% (parmi les + eleves du secteur).
kpis.description_en: Pipeline & Storage segment NI (Atmos Pipeline-Texas + Louisiana transmission). APT rate base $5.24B, authorized ROE 11.45% (top-tier in US utilities).

kpis.signal: CA Distribution porte par hausses tarifaires reglementees, decouplage volatilite gaz
kpis.description_fr: Revenus regules du segment distribution (8 etats). Decouple du cout du gaz (pass-through), donc visibilite forte sur l'operating income.
kpis.description_en: Distribution segment regulated revenues (8 states). Gas cost pass-through means operating income is largely insulated from commodity volatility.

kpis.signal: Croissance >13%/an via GRIP Texas (Gas Reliability Infrastructure Program), tarifs APT
kpis.description_fr: Revenus segment Pipeline & Storage (APT-Texas + Louisiane). Croissance soutenue par programme GRIP qui permet rajustement tarifaire annuel sur capex eligible.
kpis.description_en: Pipeline & Storage segment revenue (APT-Texas + Louisiana). Sustained growth via GRIP (annual rate adjustments on eligible capex).

kpis.signal: Plan capex >3.5 Mds$/an, dont 75% Distribution: modernisation pipelines, securite. Rate base growth ~10% par an
kpis.description_fr: Capex total annuel (Distribution + Pipeline & Storage). Materiel pour la these: chaque dollar investi alimente la rate base qui genere l'ROE reglemente.
kpis.description_en: Total annual capex (Distribution + Pipeline & Storage). Crucial: each dollar invested feeds the rate base that earns regulated ROE.

kpis_story.description_fr: Croissance population Texas (#1 driver Atmos, ~65% revenue) +1.5%/an structurel. Renforce visibilité customer add + rate base growth 2025-2030.
kpis_story.description_en: Texas population growth (Atmos #1 driver, ~65% revenue) +1.5%/yr structural. Reinforces customer add + rate base growth visibility 2025-2030.
